threads.body: `WorkflowInvocation` is part of the public surface (`opentelemetry.util.genai.invocation`). Replacing the public `name` attribute with a private `_name` breaks existing callers and forces tests to reach into a private field. Keep `name` as a public read-only property (backed by `_name`) so callers can still read it without mutating start-time attributes (util guideline 1000003: API backwards compatibility).
